evidence.claim: Buhari approved $8.5 million to facilitate the immediate evacuation of at least 5,000 Nigerians fleeing the Russia-Ukraine war.
evidence.title: Buhari orders release of $8.5m to evacuate Nigerians caught up in Russia-Ukraine war
evidence.excerpt: Buhari approved $8.5 million to facilitate the immediate evacuation of at least 5,000 Nigerians fleeing the Russia-Ukraine war.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Contemporaneous local reporting quoting government officials on a specific presidential approval and evacuation plan.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributed to Buhari through the approval described by ministers.
contrary_evidence: This shows humanitarian response, not conflict de-escalation by itself.

evidence.claim: The federal government said 1,625 citizens had been evacuated from Ukraine following the Russian invasion.
evidence.title: FG: 1,625 Nigerians evacuated from Ukraine
evidence.excerpt: The federal government said 1,625 citizens had been evacuated from Ukraine following the Russian invasion.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Contemporaneous Nigerian media reporting on an official government update; useful corroboration of the evacuation effort.
evidence.ruler_attribution: This is attributable to Buhari's government and evacuation policy, though not to his personal command of the flights.
contrary_evidence: It confirms an evacuation outcome, but not the full scale of need or operational quality.

evidence.claim: Buhari urged more collaboration across borders to check terrorism, banditry and insurgency, and said the war in Ukraine had undermined global food security while instability in Libya continued to fuel terrorism in the Sahel and West/Central Africa.
evidence.title: President Buhari Calls for more International Collaboration to Tackle Insecurity
evidence.excerpt: Buhari urged more collaboration across borders to check terrorism, banditry and insurgency, and said the war in Ukraine had undermined global food security while instability in Libya continued to fuel terrorism in the Sahel and West/Central Africa.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary presidential statement, clearly dated, with direct foreign-policy and security framing.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to Buhari as head of state and public security spokesman.
contrary_evidence: The claim about broader causal links is interpretive and not itself proof of policy effectiveness.

evidence.claim: VOA concluded that Buhari's assertion that weapons from the Ukraine war were entering West Africa lacked public evidence and was unsubstantiated.
evidence.title: Unsubstantiated: Buhari Claim That Ukraine War Feeds Arms to West Africa
evidence.excerpt: VOA concluded that Buhari's assertion that weapons from the Ukraine war were entering West Africa lacked public evidence and was unsubstantiated.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Independent fact-checking outlet assessing a specific Buhari claim against available evidence.
evidence.ruler_attribution: It addresses Buhari's own statement and the evidentiary support for it.
contrary_evidence: VOA is a fact-check, not a comprehensive arms-trafficking investigation, so it can disprove overclaiming without mapping the whole trafficking network.

evidence.claim: Buhari said West African leaders needed an ECOWAS that was economically integrated, politically stable, and socially harmonious, and that conflict management, security, democracy, and rule of law remained central regional tasks.
evidence.title: The ECOWAS we Desire, and Must Have, By President Buhari
evidence.excerpt: Buhari said West African leaders needed an ECOWAS that was economically integrated, politically stable, and socially harmonious, and that conflict management, security, democracy, and rule of law remained central regional tasks.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary presidential audience statement with explicit regional peace/governance framing.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly Buhari's own statement as Nigeria's president and ECOWAS host state leader.
contrary_evidence: This is a stated preference and agenda, not proof that outcomes matched the rhetoric.

evidence.claim: Buhari said Nigeria, through ECOWAS, had supported Guinea-Bissau's democratic order and imposed sanctions on 19 individuals who impeded implementation of the Conakry Agreement, helping restore peace in the country.
evidence.title: President Buhari Vows the Defence of Democracy In Africa
evidence.excerpt: Buhari said Nigeria, through ECOWAS, had supported Guinea-Bissau's democratic order and imposed sanctions on 19 individuals who impeded implementation of the Conakry Agreement, helping restore peace in the country.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary presidential visit statement with concrete regional action and sanction details.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to Buhari as the visiting head of state describing Nigeria's role.
contrary_evidence: The source is self-presentational and does not independently verify each sanction's causal effect.

evidence.claim: Buhari said Nigeria would support efforts to bring peaceful resolution and reconciliation on the Korean peninsula, and that his administration would continue to support peace initiatives and efforts in the West African sub-region.
evidence.title: President Buhari Calls for Lasting Peace on Korean Peninsula
evidence.excerpt: Buhari said Nigeria would support efforts to bring peaceful resolution and reconciliation on the Korean peninsula, and that his administration would continue to support peace initiatives and efforts in the West African sub-region.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary presidential video-message text, dated and directly attributable to Buhari.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct Buhari speech, though the Korean-peninsula part is largely rhetorical and general-purpose diplomacy.
contrary_evidence: General peace rhetoric does not prove concrete conflict settlement by itself.
